BiblicalUsage: eleeinós is the word for miserable. In 1 Corinthians 15:19, the text says "we are of all men most miserable."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, eleeinós, does its job quietly — miserable — and I leave it at that.
RelatedEvents: The Resurrection; The Letter to the Church in Laodicea
